beschreibung: Grunddaten des Rechners für das Protokoll.

argumente: [Console]::OutputEncoding=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8; $cs=Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem; $b=Get-CimInstance Win32_BIOS; $c=Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor|Select -First 1; $o=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; 'Hersteller: '+$cs.Manufacturer; 'Modell: '+$cs.Model; 'Seriennummer: '+$b.SerialNumber; 'BIOS: '+$b.SMBIOSBIOSVersion+' vom '+$b.ReleaseDate.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd'); 'CPU: '+$c.Name+' ('+$c.NumberOfCores+' Kerne)'; 'RAM: '+[math]::Round($cs.TotalPhysicalMemory/1GB,1)+' GB'; 'System: '+$o.Caption+' '+$o.Version

d=/sys/class/dmi/id; echo "Hersteller: $(cat $d/sys_vendor 2>/dev/null)"; echo "Modell: $(cat $d/product_name 2>/dev/null)"; echo "BIOS: $(cat $d/bios_version 2>/dev/null) vom $(cat $d/bios_date 2>/dev/null)"; echo "CPU: $(grep -m1 'model name' /proc/cpuinfo | cut -d: -f2 | sed 's/^ *//') ($(grep -c '^processor' /proc/cpuinfo) Threads)"; echo "RAM: $(awk '/MemTotal/ {printf "%.1f GB", $2/1048576}' /proc/meminfo)"; echo "Kernel: $(uname -sr)"
